description: A delicious 3-day food trip to Tokyo, exploring street food, local markets, and hands-on cooking experiences.

accommodation.amenities: restaurant, spa, pool, airport shuttle, breakfast included

days.title: Arrival and Ginza Street Food Exploration
days.description: Arrive in Tokyo, check into your hotel, and immediately dive into the city's vibrant street food scene in Ginza.

activities.notes: What you'll see: Bustling streets and hidden food stalls in Ginza.What to bring: Comfortable walking shoes and an appetite.What to eat: A variety of local street food delicacies.Good to know: This tour is a great introduction to Tokyo's culinary landscape.

days.title: Hands-on Cooking and Shibuya Night Market
days.description: Learn to cook Japanese dishes with a local chef in the afternoon, then experience the lively Shibuya night market.

activities.activity_name: Tokyo Cooking Class with Local Chef — Afternoon Edition
activities.notes: What you'll see: A local kitchen setting and traditional Japanese ingredients.What to bring: Your enthusiasm for cooking and a camera.What to eat: Dishes you prepare yourself, like sushi or ramen.Good to know: This class offers a hands-on cultural and culinary experience.

activities.activity_name: Tokyo Night Market & Tapas Crawl — Evening Edition
activities.notes: What you'll see: Vibrant night market stalls and lively Shibuya streets.What to bring: Cash for small purchases and an open mind for new flavors.What to eat: Various Japanese tapas and street snacks.Good to know: This is a great way to experience Tokyo's nightlife and casual dining.

days.title: Ueno Cooking Class and Farewell Dinner
days.description: Enjoy another cooking class in Ueno to deepen your culinary skills, followed by a relaxing evening.

activities.activity_name: Tokyo Cooking Class with Local Chef
activities.notes: What you'll see: A traditional Japanese cooking environment.What to bring: A desire to learn and comfortable attire.What to eat: Authentic Japanese dishes prepared by you.Good to know: This class provides insight into Japanese home cooking techniques.
